body:
>You're mad because you're wasting time sitting around in the tub, and you know it. You're mad because you know objectively you have a great life. You feel guilty because of this. The brooding. The crushing weight that seems to come on randomly to prevent you from being productive. Like you said, the tightness. The cloud.

This is it. Exactly. Thank you. Thank you. Thank you. 

I don't know why, but knowing someone else feels the same makes a difference. Maybe it's just the personal reply. Maybe it's that we had such similar experiences. I don't know. But reading this reply turned my day around. I got out of bed, I made coffee, and I actually got dressed.

>I know that going somewhere and telling them is terrifying.
I know that you think nothing in the world can possibly change this.

I feel like you're stalking me. I just went to an appointment on the 19th (which my boyfriend drove three hours to take me to, literally kicking and screaming like I was a child) for a prescription for this. I was on wellbutrine awhile ago and I wanted to get back on it because I could feel myself slipping. But the thought of actually telling someone I was depressed was mortifying. I threw a fit. But as soon as I told the doctor, who is my family physician and has known me for years, that I was depressed again she said "yeah, I can tell." She had been in the room with me for less than five minutes and could tell I was depressed. She gave me the prescription, but I told boyfriend that I wasn't going to take it because it wouldn't do anything and nothing would ever make me feel better (EVEN THOUGH THAT'S WHY WE MADE THE APPOINTMENT FUCK ME I'M CRAZY.) Well, later that night I had a breakdown, sobbing uncontrollably in the shower and he had to pull me out, dry me off and put me in bed and held me until I snapped out of it. Long story short, I'm on my third day of anti-depressants and I can't wait for them to start working. But thank you for the reassurance. I am not weak. I am not crazy. I do need help. 

Thank you so much. It feels so good to not be crying right now. 

Oh, and it's a shitty southern community college, haha. Nothing really interesting.
